##### Project general facts

Essence Residence is a contemporary residential development by Harmony Group, designed according to the brand’s “people-first development” philosophy, where architecture, infrastructure, and technology are centered around real-life needs and everyday comfort. The project features a refined architectural concept in a classic European style, defined by clean lines, neutral tones, and a balanced, timeless aesthetic. The development comprises a collection of studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, as well as duplex units, with an average size of approximately 65 sqm.

Residents benefit from a comprehensive range of lifestyle amenities designed for everyday living, including a rooftop infinity pool, lounge areas with a bar, an open-air cinema, a fully equipped gym, sauna, restaurant, co-working café, children’s play areas, and landscaped communal spaces. The project also offers underground parking, concierge-style services, and smart home technologies such as climate control, automated systems, and enhanced sound insulation.

The design emphasizes modern minimalism with panoramic glazing, open-plan layouts, and natural tones. Interiors are delivered with a strong focus on quality and practicality. Apartments come fully equipped with modern kitchens, including built-in appliances such as a cooktop, oven with microwave function, dishwasher, refrigerator, and range hood. Smart home features enhance everyday comfort, including climate control, automated lighting, motorized curtains, and integrated control systems. High-quality finishes, multi-level lighting, dedicated workspaces, and enhanced sound insulation create a refined and functional living environment.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Rawai stands as one of Phuket’s most charming and picturesque coastal destinations, offering a unique blend of tropical serenity, authentic Thai culture, and modern island living. Located along the southern shoreline of Phuket, the area is renowned for its relaxed atmosphere, scenic waterfront promenades, and breathtaking views of the Andaman Sea and nearby islands. With its collection of luxury villas, contemporary residences, seaside restaurants, and vibrant local markets, Rawai presents an exceptional lifestyle that perfectly balances tranquility and sophistication.

Rawai is far more than a residential area - it is a vibrant lifestyle destination designed for leisure, wellness, and outdoor living. Residents and visitors can enjoy easy access to pristine beaches such as Nai Harn and Ya Nui, world-class fitness centers, wellness spas, yacht marinas, and a variety of water activities including island hopping, snorkeling, and sailing. Lush tropical landscapes, beachfront cafes, and peaceful parks further enhance the area’s laid-back ambiance, creating an ideal environment for relaxation and social connection.

The dynamic character of Rawai is enriched by its diverse dining, retail, and entertainment offerings that cater to both locals and international residents. Seafood markets, boutique shops, international schools, and stylish beach clubs are seamlessly integrated into the community, providing convenience alongside an elevated coastal lifestyle. In addition, Rawai’s strategic location allows excellent connectivity to key destinations across Phuket, including Chalong, Kata, Patong, and Phuket International Airport, making it a highly desirable location for both permanent living and holiday retreats.
